summary: Q4 Goya-native voice primitives. goya-lang gains typed slots (slots { name: int|text|bool; } blocks on @intent; InteractionType::keyword closed keyword set added) and semantic categories (category: search|playback|navigation|selection|settings|confirm|general; default general; unknown keywords are parse errors). Slot symmetry is enforced fail-closed in both directions in validate_intents and validate_intent_decl (GY-E1011): every utterance slot reference must be declared and every declared slot must be used. Utterance text syntax is unchanged from pinned grammar quitasol.utterance.v0 — typing lives in the declaration, so the grammar identifier does not change. quitasol-semantic manifest entries carry transport, category and typed slots in deterministic JSON; contract/profile identifiers unchanged (QUITASOL-INTENT-IR/1-draft, quitasol.intent.v0). No platform lowering of slots or categories: Q5 (custom Skills generation) is the intended consumer; locale/pluralisation policy remains open; no runtime exists.

library_tests.result: 105 lib + 8 intent-corpus suites passed, 0 failed, including new tests: category closed-keyword round-trip (7 keywords + default general + unknown rejected), typed-slot parsing (int/text), slot symmetry both directions (GY-E1011), duplicate slot parse error

semantic_tests.result: 31 passed, 0 failed, including the Q4 manifest test: slots and category reach deterministic JSON, undeclared-slot and unused-slot failures surface fail-closed through compile, unknown category is a parse error

platform_lowering_of_slots.reason: Q5 (custom Skills generation where supported) is the intended consumer of slots/categories for an Alexa interaction-model fragment. No mapping is implemented or claimed here.

locale_and_pluralisation_policy.reason: Open per intents.md §6; slot typing is orthogonal to utterance locale policy, which remains unresolved.

runtime_slot_filling.reason: No runtime exists (phase 3 boundary unchanged): slots are recorded and validated, never filled.

owners_ratification.reason: Unresolved per phase 0; the profile remains proposed, not ratified.
